aiRecommendation.title: Moderate Concentration Risk in Employer Base
aiRecommendation.text: The top 10 companies account for 38% of all postings, indicating moderate concentration risk. Encouraging SME growth and startup hiring could reduce dependency on large employers.
aiRecommendation.reason: High employer concentration creates vulnerability to sector-specific shocks. Diversifying the employer base strengthens labour market resilience and broadens career opportunities.
